overview.title: Help Center
overview.subtitle: Learn how to use your website management system.
overview.welcomeDesc: EchPrime helps you build and manage your professional website — from creating websites with AI, writing SEO-optimized blog posts to tracking traffic and engagement. Here is an overview of the main features.

features.dashboardDesc: View real-time overview of website traffic, leads, and engagement.
features.aiBuilderDesc: Create a professional website in just 5 minutes with AI.
features.blogDesc: Write SEO-friendly blog posts to attract more customers.
features.settingsDesc: Configure domain and invite admin staff.

overview.needHelpDesc: If you can't find the answer, contact our support team via WhatsApp or email

tab.escToClose: ESC to close · Pinch to zoom on mobile

steps.title: Dashboard Overview
steps.desc: The dashboard displays key metrics: website traffic, leads, engagement, and SEO health score.
guide: Navigate to the Dashboard from the sidebar — this is your home screen after logging in.
The Overview tab shows key metrics: total website views (Traffic), link clicks (Leads), and user engagement.
Use the Period Selector (Today / 7 days / 30 days) at the top right to change the time range for analytics.
Click Customize to drag-and-drop, show/hide metrics cards to personalize your dashboard layout.
The SEO Health Widget displays your site's SEO score out of 100 with actionable warnings — click "AI Fix All Issues" to auto-optimize.

steps.title: Enter Business Information
steps.desc: Provide basic information so AI can create the perfect website for you.
guide: Enter your Business Name (e.g., "The Cookie House", "Beauty Spa Hana").

Select your Industry — choose from: Restaurant/Cafe/F&B, Shop/Fashion/Ecommerce, Tech/IT/SaaS, Health/Dental/Clinic, Real Estate/Property, Portfolio/Freelancer/Agency, Education/Training, Gym/Fitness/Yoga, or Other.
Describe your Products / Services — AI will use this to suggest product images and layout.
Optionally add a Description for more context about your business.
Click "Continue — AI will create your website →" to start the generation process.

steps.title: AI Generates Your Website
steps.desc: AI analyzes your business information and generates the perfect design automatically.
guide: After clicking Continue, AI begins analyzing your business information.
The system then generates content & design — including layout, colors, and images matching your industry.
Finally, it prepares the preview so you can review the result.
This process typically takes 30-60 seconds. You'll see a progress bar with each step.

steps.title: Preview & Responsive Check
steps.desc: Review your AI-generated website on both Desktop and Mobile views before publishing.
guide: Once generated, you'll see the Website Preview page with your AI-created site.
Toggle between Desktop and Mobile views to check responsive layout.
Click "View Full Preview" to open the website in a new tab for a closer look.
If satisfied, proceed to publish your website. You can always edit it later in the Builder.

steps.title: AI Chat — Edit with Conversation
steps.desc: Use AI Chat to make changes to your website by simply describing what you want.
guide: Open the AI CHAT tab in the left sidebar of the Editor.
Type what you want to change — e.g., "Can you change the color to pink?" or "Add a new section".
AI will process your request and show "Preparing changes for preview..." while updating.
Use the quick suggestion chips at the bottom (e.g., "Change color", "+ Add section") for common actions.
Changes are applied in real-time to the preview — review and keep or ask for further adjustments.

steps.title: Change Template
steps.desc: Browse and switch to a different template design at any time.
guide: In the Editor, click to open the Template Gallery to browse available designs.
Use the search bar or category filters (Restaurant, E-Commerce, Beauty, Tech, Health, Education, etc.) to find the right template.
Each template shows a preview, name, description, and color palette.
Click on a template to apply it — your content will be migrated to the new design layout.
Both Free and Pro templates are available depending on your plan.

steps.title: Edit Components on Each Page
steps.desc: Use the Components panel to add, remove, and customize sections on your pages.
guide: Open the COMPO... (Components) tab in the left sidebar.
Browse component categories: Basics (Hero, CTA, About, Features, Step Process, Service Cards), Content, Media, Business, Commerce, Form & Contact, Widgets, and Layout.
Use Search blocks to quickly find a specific component type.
Drag a component from the panel to add it to your page at the desired position.
Click on any component in the preview to select and edit its content, styling, and settings.
Switch between pages using the PAGES tab to edit different sections of your website.

steps.title: Access Blog Management
steps.desc: Navigate to the Blog section from the sidebar to view and manage all your blog posts.
guide: Click "📝 Blog" in the left sidebar to open the blog management page.
You'll see a list of all your blog posts with their status (Draft / Published), category, and publish date.
Use the search bar to find specific posts, or filter by status and category.
Click [+ New Post] at the top right to start creating a new blog post.

steps.title: Create & Edit Blog Post
steps.desc: Use the rich text editor to write content, add images, and configure post settings.
guide: Enter your Post Title at the top — the URL slug is auto-generated from the title (editable).
Use the Rich Text Editor to write your content with formatting: headings, bold, italic, lists, links, and embedded images.
On the right sidebar, configure Post Settings: Category, Author, and Publish Date.
Upload a Featured Thumbnail (PNG/JPG up to 10MB) — this appears in blog listings and social shares.
Fill in Search Optimization (SEO) section: Meta Title (max 60 chars) and Meta Description (max 160 chars) for better search ranking.

steps.title: Use AI Assistant
steps.desc: Let AI help you generate blog ideas and content to save time.
guide: Click the "AI Assistant" button (purple, top right) to open the AI blog generator.
Enter your topic (e.g., "E-commerce Marketing Strategies") in the text field.
Choose a Tone of Voice: Professional, Friendly, or Persuasive.
Click "Generate Blog Idea" — AI will create a draft title, content outline, and SEO meta for you.
You can also click "Generate via AI" next to the SEO section to auto-generate meta title and description.

steps.title: Publish or Save Draft
steps.desc: Save your work as a draft or publish it live to your website.
guide: Click "Save Draft" to save your post without publishing — you can continue editing later.
Click "Publish" to make your post live on your website immediately.
Published posts appear on your website's blog page and are indexed by search engines.
You can unpublish or edit any post at any time from the blog list page.

steps.title: Domain Configuration
steps.desc: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Domains". Add custom domain, configure DNS (A Record, CNAME), and verify connection.
guide: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Domains" from the sidebar to open Domain Management.
Your default subdomain (e.g., yourstore.web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my) is automatically assigned and connected.
Click "+ Add Custom Domain" to connect your own domain (e.g., abccompany.com).
Configure DNS at your domain registrar: A Record → Point to the static IP shown, CNAME Record → Point to web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my.
Click "Verify Connection" to check DNS propagation. Status will change from "Pending Verification" to "Connected".
Use "Select primary domain" to set which domain visitors see as the main URL.

qna.emptyDesc: Try different keywords or contact support via WhatsApp.

categories.qDashboardMetrics: What metrics are shown on the Dashboard?
categories.aDashboardMetrics: The Dashboard displays three key metrics: Traffic / Views (total page visits), Leads / Clicks (link clicks and interactions), and Engagement (non-pageview user activities). Use the period selector to view data for Today, 7 days, or 30 days.
categories.qDashboardCustomize: How to customize the Dashboard layout?
categories.aDashboardCustomize: Click the Customize button at the top right of the Dashboard. A modal will appear where you can drag-and-drop to reorder metric cards, and toggle the eye icon to show or hide specific metrics.
categories.qDashboardSeo: What is the SEO Health Widget?
categories.aDashboardSeo: The SEO Health Widget displays your website's SEO score out of 100. It shows warnings like missing meta titles or unoptimized images. Click "AI Fix All Issues" to let AI automatically optimize your site's SEO.
categories.qBuilderCreate: How to create a website with AI?
categories.aBuilderCreate: Click "Build with AI" on the Dashboard or go to Builder → New. Enter your business name, select your industry, describe your products/services, then click "Continue — AI will create your website". AI will generate a complete website in about 30-60 seconds.
categories.qBuilderEdit: Can I edit the AI-generated website?
categories.aBuilderEdit: Yes! After AI generates your website, you can fully customize it using the Visual Editor. Edit text, change images, rearrange sections, adjust colors and fonts — all with a drag-and-drop interface.
categories.aBuilderMobile: Yes, all AI-generated websites are fully responsive. You can preview both Desktop and Mobile views using the toggle buttons in the Website Preview page. The layout automatically adapts to all screen sizes.
categories.qBlogCreate: How to create a new blog post?
categories.aBlogCreate: Go to "📝 Blog" in the sidebar → click [+ New Post]. Enter a title, write content using the Rich Text Editor, upload a featured thumbnail, set the category and publish date, then click Publish or Save Draft.
categories.qBlogAi: How does the AI Blog Assistant work?
categories.aBlogAi: Click the "AI Assistant" button (purple) at the top right of the blog editor. Enter your topic, choose a tone of voice (Professional, Friendly, or Persuasive), then click "Generate Blog Idea". AI will generate a title, content outline, and SEO meta for you.
categories.qBlogSeo: How to optimize blog posts for SEO?
categories.aBlogSeo: In the blog editor, scroll to the "Search Optimization (SEO)" section on the right sidebar. Fill in the Meta Title (max 60 characters) and Meta Description (max 160 characters). You can also click "Generate via AI" to auto-generate optimized meta tags.
categories.qSettingsDomain: How to connect a custom domain?
categories.aSettingsDomain: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Domains". Click "+ Add Custom Domain", enter your domain name (e.g., abccompany.com). Then configure DNS records at your domain registrar and click "Verify Connection".
categories.aSettingsDns:
After adding your domain, the system shows the required DNS records:
  • A Record — Point your domain to the static IP address shown (e.g., 162.159.140.98)
  • CNAME Record — Point to web-v2.dev.ecommercehub.my
DNS propagation typically takes 15 minutes to 48 hours depending on your registrar.
categories.aSettingsStaff: Go to "⚙️ Settings → Staff". Click "Invite Staff", enter their email address, and select a role (Viewer or Manager). They will receive an email invitation to join your workspace.
